summary: DeciderApp / Finder + Landing + Dashboard tile + Store kind toggle — 17/17 backend pytest PASS and frontend flow verified. Backend (test_iter192_finder_and_landing.py, 17/17 in 2.4s): (a) POST /decider-store/bmp-55-patterns/clone {mode:'full'} creates a decision with decider_kind='app' and a NATIVE hierarchy — exactly 10 top-level factors (no parent_id, category ∈ {primary,secondary} from Mandatory/Optional) + 28 children (parent_id + numeric weight) — every child references a real parent, no orphans. (b) {mode:'values_only'} creates same hierarchy but category='' and rating=0 on top-level (user classifies). (c) GET /decisions/{id}/finder/config returns {config:{min_options,max_options,top_n,match_rule ∈ all|any,engine ∈ deterministic|llm}, total_options>0, is_app:true}. (d) POST /decisions/{id}/finder/run {} deterministic run returns {stage,total_options,survivors,top[],top_ids,ranked} — persisted to decision. (e) Body override {min_options:2,max_options:5,top_n:3,match_rule:'any'} reflects back in top_n/match_rule and limits top to ≤3. (f) After PUT /decisions/{id} to set a leaf factor's expected_value='100' + operator='=' + data_type='numeric' with parent category='primary'+rating=5, re-run reduces survivors ≤ baseline confirming the mandatory funnel. (g) GET/PUT /api/admin/ai-wallet/config persists finder_min_options/max/top_n/match_rule/engine and a FRESH clone's /finder/config reflects the new admin defaults (4/12/7/any). Snapshot restored after test. (h) GET /decider-store/landing returns public defaults (title/subtitle/hero/cta_label/cta_target/brand_color present); PUT /landing with super token persists all 5 fields verbatim; GET /landing.html returns text/html 200 containing the exact cta_label token; PUT /landing unauthenticated → 401/403. (i) GET /decider-store?kind=app includes bmp-55-patterns and every returned item has kind='app'; ?kind=template excludes BMP. (j) Admin PUT /decider-store/bmp-55-patterns {kind:'template'} flips to template, then {kind:'app'} restores — verified via GET each time. FRONTEND (390×844 mobile viewport): PUBLIC /decider-store shows 'Decider Apps · Finders' section with FINDER badge on BMP card ('The 55 Business Model Patterns · Free · 10 · 54 · 18'); the 'Decision Templates' section is correctly hidden because zero templates currently exist (BMP is the only entry and it's kind='app'). Detail /decider-store/bmp-55-patterns shows Finder banner 'Finder — set your expectations & priorities, then it auto-ranks the best matches for you.' plus 'Full clone' vs 'Values only' picker and 'Sign in to use' CTA when logged out. LOGGED-IN (super@test.com → /admin): detail page shows 'Use this Finder' CTA; tapping it clones and lands on /prr/{id}?step=2 with 'Step 2: Define Factors & Criteria' and a purple 'Run Finder — auto-rank the best options / Set expectations (Step 2) & priorities, then find your Top matches.' banner at the top of the step. Dashboard / shows Solution Space section including 'The Decider Store' tile (via dashboardTiles.ts alwaysOn tile 'decider_store' → /decider-store). No red-screen errors; only routine Expo web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents, expo-notifications on web) — not blocking.
action_items: None required. Optional: expose testID='btn-use-finder' on the detail page CTA and testID='btn-run-finder' on the PRR Step-2 banner + /finder/{id} run button for more resilient E2E automation (currently must rely on visible text 'Use this Finder' / 'Run Finder').
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/decider_store.py::_build_decision_from_template correctly synthesizes a native MAIN → SUB hierarchy: each template factor becomes one top-level MyDezider factor (no parent_id) plus one child per real sub-factor (parent_id + weight=split_pct). Legacy factors with a single implicit sub-factor collapse onto the parent. sid_to_fid remap ensures option assessments land on the correct leaf; decider_kind='app' when the template kind='app' and finder_config copies template.finder_settings.

backend/routes/finder.py::_resolve_cfg precedence is admin_defaults → decision.finder_config → request body, and coerces/clamps min≤max, top_n≥1, match_rule ∈ {all,any}, engine ∈ {deterministic,llm} — good defensive coding.

backend/core/finder_engine.py implements the funnel deterministically: primary (mandatory) → +secondary (optional) → relaxed_all when survivors < min_options. option_worth falls back to equal weighting when no rating is set (values_only clones don't crash). Sub-factors roll up by weight; factors weighted by rating. Pure O(options × factors) — safe at 54 options.
backend/routes/decider_store.py serves /decider-store/landing.html with self-contained CSS and a masked iframe (main URL never leaves TheDecider.store) — meets PRD requirement.
backend/routes/decider_store.py::list_store correctly maps kind='app' → {kind:'app'} and kind='template' → {kind: {$ne:'app'}} (so legacy docs without a kind field still surface under templates).
frontend/app/prr/[id].tsx line 354-360 shows the 'Run Finder — auto-rank the best options' banner tile at step 2 only when decision.decider_kind === 'app' (via safeBack navigation to /finder/[id]).

frontend/src/config/dashboardTiles.ts line 76 registers 'decider_store' as alwaysOn=true in the Solution Space section — visible on the dashboard even if the persisted layout predates it (see (tabs)/index.tsx fetchLayout merge logic).
MongoDB _id is properly stripped via {'_id':0} in every read (finder_config, finder_run, list_store, get_template, get_landing) — no ObjectId leaks.
